english_translation.translator: K. M. K. Murthy / Desiraju Hanumanta Rao
english_translation.text: "These two saint-like Kusha and Lava, who also possess kingly features, but they are great hermits... this narration is endowing good fortune to me also, listen to that great efficacious legend [of Seetha...]" [So said Rama to those courtiers.] [1-4-35]

english_word_by_word.note: devanagari_machine_converted is our ITRANS->Devanagari conversion, unchecked

words.english: these two, saints, possessing kingly features,
thus great hermits like Kusha and Lava
to me, also, that, good fortune endowing
the great efficacious, legend, they tell

english_commentary.text: Here Rama tells that this legend is 'efficacious' for it is the legend of Seetha, and should it be Rama's alone, he will get the blemish of self-glorification, aatmaprashamsaa doSa , and brave heroes of legends cannot be subjected to such a blemish. And to listen to the legend of his dearest, who at present is not with him, gives a kind of consolation, and thus he is asking all of us to listen to siitaayaH caritam mahat ...
